2. इ॑ति ind. (fr. pronominal base 3. इ), in this manner, thus (in its original signification इ॑ति refers to something that has been said or thought, or lays stress on what precedes; in the Brāhmaṇas it is often equivalent to ‘as you know’, reminding the hearer or reader of certain customs, conditions, &c. supposed to be known to him). In quotations of every kind इ॑ति means that the preceding words are the very words which some person has or might have spoken, and placed thus at the end of a speech it serves the purpose of inverted commas (इ॑त्य् उक्त्वा, having so said; इ॑ति कृत्वा, having so considered, having so decided). It may often have reference merely to what is passing in the mind e.g. बालो ऽपि नावमन्तव्यो मनुष्य इ॑ति भूमिपः, a king, though a child, is not to be despised, saying to one's self, ‘he is a mortal’, (Gr. 928.) In dram. इ॑ति तथा करोति means ‘after these words he acts thus.’ Sometimes इ॑ति is used to include under one head a number of separate objects aggregated together (e.g. इज्याध्ययनदानानि तपः सत्यं क्षमा दमः । अलोभ इ॑ति मार्गो ऽयम्, ‘sacrificing, studying, liberality, penance, truth, patience, self-restraint, absence of desire’, this course of conduct, &c.) इ॑ति is sometimes followed by एवम्, इव, or a demonstrative pronoun pleonastically (e.g. ताम् ब्रूयाद् भवतीत्य् एवम्, her he may call ‘lady’, thus). इ॑ति may form an adverbial compound with the name of an author (e.g. इ॑ति-पाणिनि, thus according to Pāṇini). It may also express the act of calling attention (lo! behold!) It may have some other significations e.g. something additional (as in इ॑त्यादि, et caetera), order, arrangement specific or distinctive, and identity. It is used by native commentators after quoting a rule to express ‘according to such a rule’ (e.g. अनुदात्तङित इ॑त्य् आत्मनेपदम् भवति, according to the rule of Pāṇini, i, 3, 12, the Ātmane-pada takes place).  किम् इ॑ति = किम्, wherefore, why? (In the Śatapatha-brāhmaṇa ति occurs for इ॑ति; cf. Prākṛt ti and tti.)

(In addition to the five organs of perception, बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि or ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणि, i.e. eye, ear, nose, tongue, and skin, the Hindūs enumerate five organs of action, कर्मेन्द्रियाणि i.e. larynx, hand, foot, anus, and parts of generation; between these ten organs and the soul or आत्मन् stands मनस् or mind, considered as an eleventh organ; in the Vedānta, मनस्, बुद्धि, अहंकार, and चित्त form the four inner or internal organs, अन्तर्-इन्द्रियाणि, so that according to this reckoning the organs are fourteen in number, each being presided over by its own ruler or नियन्तृ; thus, the eye by the Sun, the ear by the Quarters of the world, the nose by the two Aśvins, the tongue by Pracetas, the skin by the Wind, the voice by Fire, the hand by Indra, the foot by Viṣṇu, the anus by Mitra, the parts of generation by Prajāpati, manas by the Moon, buddhi by Brahman, ahaṃkāra by Śiva, citta by Viṣṇu as Acyuta; in the Nyāya philosophy each organ is connected with its own peculiar element, the nose with the Earth, the tongue with Water, the eye with Light or Fire, the skin with Air, the ear with Ether; the Jainas divide the whole creation into five sections, according to the number of organs attributed to each being.)

इषिर॑ m. ([cf. Gk. ἱερός, especially in Homer (e.g. Il. xvi, 404).])
इषेत्वक: इषेत्वक mfn. containing the words इषे॑ त्वा (VS. i, 1) g. गोषदादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 62.
इषोवृधीय: इषोवृधीय n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy. iii, 4, 16.
इष्कृ: इष्-√ कृ (√ 1. कृ with इस् [= निस्, BRD.]) P. (impf. 1. sg. इष्-करम्, RV. x, 48, 8) Ā. (Impv. 2. pl. इष्-कृणुध्वम्, RV. x, 53, 7) to arrange, set in order, prepare, RV.
इष्कर्तृ: इष्-कर्तृ॑ mfn. arranging, preparing, setting in order.
इष्कृत: इ॑ष्-कृत mfn. arranged, set in order, RV.
इष्कृताहाव: इऽष्कृताहाव mfn. one whose Soma vessel is prepared or ready, RV. x, 101, 6.
इष्टकृत्: इष्ट॑—कृत् mfn. performing a sacrifice Comm. on KātyŚr.
इष्टयजुस्: इष्ट॑—यजुस् (इष्ट॑°) mfn. one who has spoken the sacrificial verses, VS.; TS.
इष्टस्विष्टकृत्: इष्ट॑—स्विष्टकृत् mfn. one to whom a Sviṣṭakṛt sacrifice has been offered, ŚBr.
इष्टाकृत: इष्टा-कृत n. for इष्टीकृत (q.v.), MBh. iii, 10513 (ed. Calc.; ed. Bomb. iii, 129, 1 reads इष्टी°).
इष्टापूर्त: इष्टापूर्त॑ n. ‘filled up or stored up sacrificial rites’, or the merit of sacred rites &c. stored up in heaven, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; R. &c. (See Muir v, 293; according to Banerjea's translation of Brahma-sūtras, p.19, इष्ट means personal piety, पूर्त works for the benefit of others).
इष्टापूर्तिन्: इष्टापूर्तिन् mfn. one who has stored up sacrificial rites, or one who has performed sacrifices for himself and good works for others.
इष्टकचित: इष्टक-चित (for the shortening of the आ See Pāṇ. vi, 3, 65) mfn. overlaid or covered with bricks, Yājñ. i, 197.
इष्टका: इ॑ष्टका f. a brick in general
a brick used in building the sacrificial altar, VS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mṛcch. &c.
इष्टकाचिति: इ॑ष्टका—चिति॑ f. putting bricks in layers or rows, ŚBr. x, 1, 3, 8.
इष्टकान्यास: इ॑ष्टका—न्यास m. laying the foundation of a house.
इष्टकापथ: इ॑ष्टका—पथ n. the root of the fragrant grass Andropogon Muricatus, Bhpr.
इष्टकापशु: इ॑ष्टका—पशु m. sacrificing an animal during the preparation of bricks Comm. on VS.
इष्टकापुराण: इष्टका-पुराण n. N. of the 10th Pariś of Kāty.
इष्टकामात्रा: इ॑ष्टका—मात्रा॑ f. size of the bricks, ŚBr.
इष्टकाराशि: इ॑ष्टका—राशि m. a pile of bricks.
इष्टकावत्: इ॑ष्टका—वत् mfn. possessed of bricks, Pāṇ.
इष्टकासंपद्: इ॑ष्टका—संपद् f. completeness of the bricks, ŚBr.
इष्टकैकशतविध: इ॑ष्टकैक-शत-विध mfn. corresponding to the 101 bricks, ŚBr. x, 2, 6, 11.
इष्टित्व: इ॑ष्टि—त्व n. the being an Iṣṭi sacrifice, AitBr.; Jaim.
इष्टिपच: इ॑ष्टि—पच or इ॑ष्टि—मुष्, m. an Asura, demon, L.
इष्टिमय: इष्टि—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of sacrifices, VP.
इष्टिमुष्: इ॑ष्टि—पच or इ॑ष्टि—मुष्, m. an Asura, demon, L.
इष्टियाजुक: इ॑ष्टि—या॑जुक mfn. one who offers an Iṣṭi sacrifice, ŚBr.
इष्टिरूप: इष्टि—रूप॑ n. the property of the Iṣṭi, ŚBr.
इष्टिश्राद्ध: इ॑ष्टि—श्राद्ध n. a particular funeral rite, VP.
इष्टिहौत्र: इ॑ष्टि—हौत्र n. the office of an Hotṛ at an Iṣṭi sacrifice Comm. on TBr. iii, 5, 1.
इष्ट्ययन: इष्ट्य्-अयन n. a sacrifice lasting a long time, ĀśvŚr.
इष्टिन्: इष्टि॑न् mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 88) one who has sacrificed, TS.; Kāṭh.
इष्टीकृत: इष्टी-कृत n. a particular sacrifice or festive rite, MBh.
इष्ट्वा: इष्ट्वा॑ ind.p. having sacrificed or worshipped, AV.
इष्ट्वीनम्: इष्ट्वीनम् ind. = इष्ट्वा, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 48, Sch.
इष्टनि: इष्टनि mfn. (fr. √ यज्), to be worshipped, RV. i, 127, 6 ([Sāy.])
accord. to others = इषं तन्वन्, RV.
इष्टर्ग: इष्ट॑र्ग m. (etym. doubtful), the Adhvaryu priest ([Sāy.]), TS. and, TBr.
इष्य: इष्य m. the spring, L. (= इष्म, col.1).
इस्: इस् ind. an interjection of anger or pain or sorrow, L.
(according to, BRD. इस् Ved. = निस् cf. इष्-√ कृ above.)
इह: इह॑ ind. (fr. pronom. base 3. इ), in this place, here
in this case (e.g. तेनेह न, ‘therefore not in this case’ i.e. the rule does not apply here)
इह [cf. Zend idha, ‘here’ ; Gk. ἰθα or ἰθαι in ἰθα-γενής and ἰθαι-γενής; Goth. ith; perhaps Lat. igi-tur.]
इहकार: इह॑—कार m. the word इह, Lāṭy.
इहक्रतु: इह॑—क्रतु or इह॑—चित्त, mfn. one whose intentions or thoughts are in this world or place, AV. xviii, 4, 38.
इहचित्त: इह॑—क्रतु or इह॑—चित्त, mfn. one whose intentions or thoughts are in this world or place, AV. xviii, 4, 38.
इहत्र: इह॑—त्र ind. here, in this world.
इहपञ्चमी: इह॑—पञ्चमी f. being here (in this place, world, &c.) the second or fifth woman, (g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 72.)
इहभोजन: इह॑—भोजन (इह॑°) mfn. whose goods and gifts come hither, AV. xviii, 4, 49.
इहमनस्: इह—मनस् mfn. having the mind turned hither, ĀpŚr.
इहलोक: इह॑—लोक m. this world, this life
इहलोके: इह॑—लोके ind. in this world, MBh.; Mn.; Pañcat. &c.
इहवत्: इह॑—वत् n. N. of several Sāmans.
इहसमये: इह॑—समये ind. here, now, on the present occasion, at such a time as this.
इहस्थ: इह॑—स्थ mfn. standing here, Ratnāv.; Bālar. &c.
इहस्थान: इह॑—स्थान mfn. one whose place or residence is on the earth
इहागत: इहागत mfn. come or arrived hither.
इहामुत्र: इहामुत्र ind. here and there, in this world and in the next, Vedāntas. &c.
इहार्थ: इ—°हार्थ mfn. useful here (i.e. for this world), MBh.
इहार्थम्: इ—°हार्थम् ind. for the sake of this world, Bcar.
इहार्थिन्: इ—°हार्थिन् mfn. busy in worldly objects, Mn. ii, 37
इहेह: इहे॑ह ind. here and there, now and then, repeatedly
इहेहमातृ: इहे॑ह—मातृ a m. one whose mother is here and there i.e. everywhere, RV. vi, 59, 1.
इ—°हेह-मातृ b others, ‘born at the same time’.
इहत्य: इहत्य mfn. being here, Kathās.; Daś. &c.
इहेड: इहेड n. N. of a Sāman, TBr.
